correctness.rationale: For nested nonempty centrally symmetric compact A_t⊂R^d with both left-union and right-intersection order continuity, compactness gives Hausdorff-continuity of t↦A_t; uniqueness of bounded symmetry centers and limit preservation give continuity of c_t. For partition increments v_i=c_{t_i}-c_{t_{i-1}}, a fractional-dependence rounding lemma yields ε_i∈{0,1} with ||Σ(ε_i-1/2)v_i||<=d max||v_i||/2. Two legally sequential central reflections move a retained point by 2v_i without escaping A_{t_i}; nesting handles skipped increments. The final point lies in A_t within d max||v_i|| of c_t+y. Fine partitions and closedness prove A_s-c_s⊆A_t-c_t. Rounding is finite-dimensional; does not establish strict/strong nestedness.

value.rationale: Directly resolves a stated mathematical conjecture about centrally symmetric hyperspace arcs and gives a broadly reusable exact center-tracking argument via vector discrepancy and successive reflections. The theorem covers nonconvex compact sets and separates ordinary from strong nesting, a meaningful structural distinction rather than a minor parameter tweak.

limitations: Order-continuous nested nonempty compact centrally symmetric sets only.
